# Handoff: Synthetic Shop

## Overview
A synthetic README shaped like a design handoff. Not real client data.

## Design tokens

**Colour**
| Token | Value | Use |
|---|---|---|
| Page background | `#faf8f5` | Body, header |
| Ink | `#141414` | Primary text |
| Faint text | `#8b8478` | Captions |
| Accent (default) | `#9C8B78` | Focus rings |
| Messaging | `#25D366` on `#0B2B17` text; tint `#E9F9EF` with `#B7E5C7` border | Chat CTAs |
| Short hex | `#fff` | Panels |
| Display face | Serif Display | No hex here |

| Route | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `/` | Home |

**Typography**
- Display: **Serif Display**, weights 500 / 600 / 700. Headings and prices.
- Body / UI: **Sans Body**, weights 300–600.
- Review panel only: **Roboto**, 400 / 500.
- Scale: h1 48px desktop / 34px mobile.

**Spacing**
- Section padding: `104px 52px` desktop / `56px 20px` mobile.
- Max content width: `1440px`, centred.
- Grid gaps: `2px` hairline, `16px` rails.

**Other**
- Border radius: `0` almost everywhere; pills at `50%`.
- Shadows: only two: header on scroll, and modals at `0 30px 70px rgba(0,0,0,.18)`.
